parsed.observations: Many leaves have extensive tan to brown necrotic blotches and numerous small black dots within damaged tissue. Some remaining green leaves show elongated tan lesions bounded by veins. Small brown marks occur on stems, but diagnostic rust pustules are not clearly resolved. No white powdery growth is visible.
parsed.summary: The visible leaf necrosis, vein-bounded tan blotches, and numerous black dots within lesions support Septoria leaf blotch.
